description: Cheese starter cultures, mould (Penicillium) cultures and yogurt or kefir cultures sold in Polish shops (kultury bakteryjne, kultura do sera, jaką kulturę kupić do twarogu, jogurtu, kefiru, pleśń): which culture to use for a cheese such as quark, mozzarella, camembert or feta, and where to buy it. Each result: name, type, use, working temperature, shop, price with date, price per litre of milk, link to the culture card. Filters: type, temperature, shop; sort by price per litre. Field zapytanie takes Polish words, e.g. "twaróg", "camembert", "jogurt grecki"; every word must match the name, use, type or composition. [Moduł wiedzy Moja Serowarnia, https://mojaserowarnia.pl; hub przekazuje pytanie do jego serwera]
